acceptanceCriteria: AICockpit can submit a proposed implementation plan to canonical state.
AICockpit can read plan status and details for agent workflow coordination.
AICockpit cannot approve, defer, reject, verify, or close plan-controlled work through human-only paths.
testSteps: Focused AICockpit command tests for plan submit/read behavior and denied human-only decisions.

workItem.title: Add AICockpit plan submission and read commands
